name: Night Run
summary: In east-central Ashenvale, the Felmusk satyr hold Night Run among ancient elven ruins. Dark soul magic gathers within their outpost.

sections.title: A Defended Cliffside Perch
sections.body:
Night Run is Ashenvale’s smallest and most isolated of its three great satyr strongholds, with Xavian and Satyrnaar. Crumbling elven stonework and broken pillars shelter the settlement on a high ridge, ringed by steep cliffs no traveler can cross.

You can follow the Falfarren River near Xavian’s waters, then turn west up the ridge. Or take the precarious northern ledge above Raynewood Retreat. The Felmusk satyr have joined the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand. Together they anchor twisted soulgems here to gather demonic essence in the forest.

faq.answer: The Felmusk satyr occupy Night Run. These demonic night elf corrupters are affiliated with the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: How do you reach Night Run?
aliases: how to get to night run
faq.answer: Night Run crowns an elevated bluff bounded by sheer cliffs. You can approach by a narrow ledge north of Raynewood Retreat, or follow the Falfarren River toward Xavian before turning west up the ridge.

faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand doing here?
aliases: cult of the dark strand night run
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand works alongside the satyrs at Night Run. They maintain a dark soulgem there to harvest and channel demonic energies across Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you see an enduring scar at Night Run. Ancient elven stones shelter the twisted Felmusk.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Night Run just north of Raynewood Retreat. The demonic menace overlooks crucial Sentinel supply lines.
